- Error taxonomy: finalizing error buckets and mapped alert severity.
- Alert routing & runbooks: routing rules, on-call play, and runbook drafts for top-10 incidents.

Proposed workshop window: Nov 1 or Nov 2, 10:00–11:30 PT. Agenda (draft):
1) Ownership matrix walkthrough (15m)
2) Dashboard lineage and access checks (20m)
3) Tracing tagging + sampling plan (20m)
4) Alert routing and runbook sign-off (20m)
5) Next steps & action owners (15m)

Please confirm: which date works, who from Ops will join (name + email), and whether the attached artifacts (dashboard mockup + runbook draft + SLO matrix) are a helpful starting point. Im attaching the artifacts referenced above.

Thanks,
